interpretation_of_access_modes.Regular: landing is the action required to obtain the predictive cue
interpretation_of_access_modes.Random_Free_Cue: the predictive cue is supplied independently of landing, so landing is no longer required for information

conclusion: The effect of decision difficulty on platform landing depends strongly on whether landing is necessary to obtain information. The regular-trial difficulty gradient is not a generic motor/difficulty response: it changes sign when the cue is supplied independently of the acquisition action.
claim_ceiling: Direct causal component validation of need-dependent costly acquisition versus unconditional/free information access; not a full test of branch-specific alternative next-cue routeability or deterministic C_A<C_F.
